summary: TWO BEDROOM APARTMENT We are pleased to welcome to the market this well-presented second floor apartment, offering spacious and modern accommodation throughout. The property comprises a welcoming hallway leading into a bright and airy open-plan lounge and dining area, a fully fitted kitchen, one double bedroom, one generously sized single bedroom, and a contemporary family bathroom with shower.

TWO BEDROOM 2ND FLOOR APARTMENT

We are pleased to welcome to the market this well-presented second floor apartment, offering spacious and modern accommodation throughout. The property comprises a welcoming hallway leading into a bright and airy open-plan lounge and dining area, a fully fitted kitchen, one double bedroom, one generously sized single bedroom, and a contemporary family bathroom with shower.
